findings.description: At 00:00-00:10 the vehicle parked in the lot is a white semi tractor-trailer (light-colored cab with a long white trailer). When the man exits the diner at 01:43 he walks to a dark green conventional-cab box truck (single-unit with integrated cargo box, chrome exhaust stacks) — a different body type, color, and overall configuration. The overnight elapsed time alone does not explain it: no swap is shown on screen and no second vehicle appears to account for the change, yet the man treats the green box truck as his own.
